drag_fit — DRIVE ball op

• Data kinds: signal × points × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.drag_fit(t, p, bp: 'dict', *, iters: 'int' = 20, dt: 'float' = 0.001) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import ballistics; ballistics.drag_fit(t, p, bp: 'dict', *, iters: 'int' = 20, dt: 'float' = 0.001) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("drag_fit"))

Usage

Fits the "gravity + drag" model to a trajectory (t_i, p_i) with 7 parameters (p₀, v₀, C_d) (5 for planar input) — the no-thrust version of thrust_fit (flight_fit keeps C_d known with 6 parameters; this one identifies C_d too). The result keys and the entrance checks (dt ≤ sample spacing, iters ≥ 1, vacuum refused) are those of thrust_fit, with thrust a zero vector. From a ground-truth trajectory C_d returns to 1e-4 (gate).

Empty input (t with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
